cohort: 3813 mothers of newborns in eight hospitals in Catania, Sicily, Italy, from 2016 to 2018
finding: While overall breastfeeding rates were high, exclusive breastfeeding rates were lower, particularly among mothers who had cesarean deliveries, with hospital-specific factors, such as dedicated staff, appearing to play a more significant role than prenatal course attendance or maternal education level.
mod_finding: Only 35% of women who had a caesarean section adopted exclusive breastfeeding.
